# Boiler Room Smoking Lounge

> A private cigar and pipe smoking lounge in the basement of the historic York Rite Building, downtown Austin, Texas. Open to the public Thursday through Saturday, and to members 24/7 via personal locker access.

## Business Details
- Address: 311 West 7th Street, Basement of the York Rite Building, Austin, TX 78701
- Phone: 512-845-1137
- Public hours: Thursday–Saturday, Noon–8:00 PM. Members have 24/7 access via a personal locker entry code.
- Membership: $40/month (month-to-month, cancel anytime) or $400/year (annual, roughly two months free vs. monthly). Both tiers include a personal humidor locker and 24/7 lounge access.
- After joining: call 512-845-1137 or visit in person and ask for Carl to get your locker number and entry code assigned.
- Member perks: a welcome package (cigar, T-shirt, and other goodies) plus invitations to members' dinners and other events throughout the year.
- Policy: Boiler Room is a bring-your-own lounge — bring your own cigars, pipe tobacco, and beverages. Nothing is sold on-site.
- Age requirement: 21 and older.
- Guest policy: guests are welcome any time when accompanied by a member, but must leave when the member leaves. Otherwise the lounge is open to guests only during public hours.
- Seating: open, first-come-first-served, mixed leather and other lounge seating.
